history.summary: The Durgapur row is best matched to the private 'Sri Ramakrishna Vivekananda Sevashrama' at Vidya Sagar Road / Rammohan Avenue near Lala Lajpat Rai Avenue and Parashar Road, A-Zone, Durgapur 713204 (Justdial: 4.7/5, 52 ratings; open 5:00-8:00 PM daily per listing). FLAG: this is a private sevashrama and NOT an official branch centre of the Ramakrishna Math / Ramakrishna Mission (Belur Math) - no official RKM branch exists in Durgapur; the nearest official centre is Ramakrishna Mission Sevashrama, Bankura. Founding date and deity layout are not documented online; deities/festivals listed are the standard pattern for Ramakrishna-following centres, not confirmed for this ashrama.

town_description: Durgapur is a planned industrial city in the Paschim Bardhaman district of West Bengal, known as the 'Steel City of India'. Built around the Durgapur Steel Plant in the 1950s, it is West Bengal's second-largest urban agglomeration after Kolkata, home to steel, power and engineering industries, the Kazi Nazrul Islam Airport at Andal, the Durgapur Barrage on the Damodar river, and religious landmarks such as the Rahreswar Shiv Mandir and the Bhiringi Shamshan Kali Temple (1852).
